Researched in separate searches and written as separate people. BAND IS MEDIUM, NOT HIGH, for two honest reasons: (1) only ONE official-source domain corroborates him, yashodahospitals.com - the several Yashoda URLs above are different pages of that same site, and LinkedIn does not count as an independent official source under section 5 of the brief; (2) 'Dr K Ashok Kumar' is a common Indian name and search surfaced at least two probable DIFFERENT Hyderabad doctors of that name - a Medical Oncologist at American Oncology Institute Nallagandla (Skedoc, 5 years experience) and one at Omega Hospitals. I therefore deliberately did NOT record those Skedoc or Omega URLs in directory_profile, because I cannot prove they are the same man; a human should treat any 'Dr K Ashok Kumar' result outside yashodahospitals.com as unverified. Per the brief, yashodahospitals.com and linkedin.com are blocked to the fetcher, so all URLs are recorded exactly as returned verbatim by WebSearch - none opened, none constructed. No email and no phone number appeared verbatim anywhere in search output, so all contact number and email fields are blank rather than guessed; Yashoda publishes no per-doctor line and routes contact through the per-doctor booking widget. Experience left unconfirmed: the input says 18 years but no source returned a year-count for this doctor, and the '5 years' figure in search belongs to the different Nallagandla doctor - do not carry that figure across. One aggregated search summary also asserted '350 transplants performed'; I could not attribute that figure to a specific page with certainty, so I omitted it from hni_signals.
